flawless: I have walked through the heart of the Flarg, and you were barely a campfire.
The pilgrimage continues. You were a short detour.
solid: My robes are scorched in new places. Every pilgrim needs scars.
Your fire was honest. Mine was older.
close: My flame nearly guttered out. I must pray at the first shrine I find.
That was a hard road, stranger. I'll walk the rest of it slowly.
